ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and VFSC disqualified-persons registers; enhanced due diligence mandatory for politically exposed persons (PEPs) as defined under the AML/CFT Act No. 46 of 2020, including family members and close associates; adverse media and negative-news checks required prior to incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Services Portal - Online Company Name Reservation System (vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in English and/or French and use Latin-script characters only; the name must be distinguishable from any existing registered name in Vanuatu and must not be misleading or imply connection with a sovereign, government, or public authority; an International Company must include a mandatory suffix: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Société Anonyme', or 'SA'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A reserved name lapses automatically after 30 days unless the company is incorporated within that window; a written request for a one-time extension may be submitted to the VFSC Registry via the e-Services portal before expiry, subject to an additional statutory fee. On rejection under section 7 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222), the applicant may: (i) file a written request for reconsideration with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice; (ii) if reconsideration is refused, lodge a formal administrative appeal to the Minister responsible for financial services within 21 days; (iii) alternatively, submit a revised distinguishable name through the portal without prejudice.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Industry-compatible: ISIC 5912 (automated subtitle transcription and AI voice cloning studio) is a non-licensed activity requiring neither a physical production premises nor a statutory operational site in Vanuatu; however, every International Company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the physical address of its licensed registered agent. A purely remote/virtual office is not accepted as a substitute for the statutory registered office, although all production activities may be conducted offshore.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - estimated annual probability below 5% for a non-licensed International Company not engaged in a geographically mobile 'relevant activity' under the Economic Substance Rules; unannounced on-site inspections are triggered primarily by suspicious transaction reports, adverse intelligence, or regulatory complaints, in which case VFSC or the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit may conduct targeted premises checks.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Act No. 32 of 1992), as amended; ss. 4–6 (Incorporation by Memorandum and Articles), s. 13 (Registered Office), ss. 53–57 (Directors and Registered Agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association accompanied by Application for Registration as an International Company (Form IC-1)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; the subscriber may declare issued capital of USD 1 or any amount in any currency; no escrow or capital deposit account is required for an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that: (a) the board approves the allotment of one ordinary share to each subscriber under the Declaration of Capital delivered to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; (b) the registered office of the Company shall be situated in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the registered agent is authorised to file all statutory notices under the International Companies Act; (c) the individuals named in the Memorandum are appointed as first directors; (d) the registered agent is authorised to pay all government fees and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation; and (e) the directors are authorised to open bank accounts, appoint a corporate secretary, and execute all agreements to commence business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name reservation request with the proposed company name followed by 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' to the VFSC Companies Registry; obtain a name search certificate confirming the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company; all submissions must be made through a licensed registered agent in Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Identity details of the licensed registered agent
Proof of payment of name search fee (VUV 5,000)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the applicant may resubmit with an alternative name or file a written objection within 14 days; VFSC will issue a formal determination which can be appealed to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent must file the signed Memorandum and Articles of Association together with the Application for Registration as an International Company (Form IC-1), declaration of capital, and registered agent consent form; documents must be in English and notarised if executed by non-resident subscribers.
required_dossiers: Application for Registration as an International Company (Form IC-1)
Registered agent consent and address in Port Vila
Subscriber identification documents (passport or incorporation certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC raises an objection or queries a document, the registered agent may resubmit corrected documents within 21 days without additional fee; judicial review is available for persistent refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Revenue and Accounting Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After satisfactory review, VFSC issues a fee invoice covering the annual government licence fee and registration fee; payment must be made by bank transfer or card to the VFSC official account, with reference to the company draft number; no escrow deposit is required.
required_dossiers: Payment remittance advice or online payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late payment results in withdrawal of the application; reinstate by paying an additional late fee not exceeding 20% of the invoiced amount and submitting a fresh application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon confirmation of payment and final compliance review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the extract of particulars; the registered agent collects the original certificate and archives the company minute book at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Compliance clearing memorandum from registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is withheld due to suspected non-compliance, the registered agent must submit a corrective statutory declaration; the Registrar will then issue the certificate within 5 business days, subject to a VUV 10,000 reinstatement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Bank Account Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent and Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting, adopt the board resolutions on share allotment and officer appointments, issue share certificates, appoint the company secretary, open the corporate minute book, and arrange for opening of corporate bank or payment-rail accounts (e.g., Stripe, Wise) using the Certificate of Incorporation and board resolution.
required_dossiers: Director and beneficial owner identification (AML/sanctions screening)
Bank account opening forms and source of funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank due diligence rejects the application due to missing beneficial ownership data, amend the register of members, provide group structure chart, and resubmit with a notarised resolution confirming the source of funds; AML complaints may be escalated to the VFSC Banking and Trusts Division.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no statutory industrial licence for offshore International Companies engaged in ISIC 5912 (automated subtitle transcription and AI voice cloning); a Vanuatu Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 228] is only required if physical commercial activity is carried on within Vanuatu.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards and Environment)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – IT-based post-production digital service with no physical manufacturing, no point-source discharge, and no land disturbance; EIA registration not triggered under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [Cap 283].
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or particulate emission thresholds applicable; general obligation to comply with noise abatement requirements of Port Vila municipal by-laws; electronic waste, if any, must be transferred to a licensed e-waste recycler; data-centre server heat output does not constitute an emission for EIA purposes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: If a physical office is established: fire safety certification under the Fire Safety Act and Port Vila municipal fire code, structural load assessment for rack and studio equipment (typically non-applicable for low-weight digital server loads), and occupational health clearance under the Health and Safety at Work Act; for a purely offshore remote digital operation with no Vanuatu premises, these clearances are waived.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (CIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Private Mail Bag 9075, Port Vila; VAT and TIN administration via the CIR VAT Office; company registry and International Company incorporation administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); official portals include www.gov.vu and the ASYCUDA World customs clearance platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; obtain Certificate of Incorporation and registered office in Port Vila. Step 2: If a Vanuatu VAT nexus arises, file the VAT Application for Registration (Form VAT 100/101) with the CIR, attaching certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, directors' passports, registered office certificate, registered agent consent, and a bank reference; non-resident applicants may be required to appoint a local fiscal representative under the VAT Act. Step 3: The CIR issues a 12-digit V-TIN/VAT registration certificate within approximately 10-15 working days. Step 4: An IC engaged exclusively in offshore services to non-residents may lawfully remain unregistered and TIN-free, as no income tax return obligation exists; voluntary VAT registration is available to recover input VAT on local production costs.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for income tax: Vanuatu has no check-the-box, look-through, fiscal unity, or hybrid mismatch elections; the International Company is statutorily exempt from income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and stamp duty under Section 39 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and cannot elect to become taxable. Voluntary VAT registration is available under Section 5 of the VAT Act [Cap 270] for persons making or intending to make taxable supplies below the mandatory threshold, enabling input-credit recovery on zero-rated export services; no BEPS Action 2 hybrid mismatch or exit tax election has been enacted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration applies to any person carrying on a taxable activity with aggregate annual turnover exceeding VUV 10,000,000 (approximately USD 84,000) in a 12-month period; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold with CIR approval. An International Company supplying digital subtitle and dubbing services exclusively to non-resident recipients generally falls outside the mandatory threshold because the supplies are zero-rated exports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, or digital stamping regime exists in Vanuatu. VAT returns are filed quarterly on paper or via the CIR e-tax portal; customs export declarations are processed through ASYCUDA World with electronic clearance at the border. Invoices must contain minimum statutory content (supplier name, TIN, description, tax rate, tax amount) under the VAT Regulations; there is no government-connected API or continuous transaction control mandate.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Section 9 of the VAT Act [Cap 270], supplies of exported goods and services supplied to non-resident persons located outside Vanuatu qualify for zero-rating where the CIR is satisfied that the goods were exported or the services were consumed outside Vanuatu. For the AI subtitle transcription and voice-cloning studio, digital post-production and audio dubbing services delivered over the internet to overseas streaming platforms, media houses, and dubbing agencies qualify as zero-rated exports where (i) the recipient is a non-resident not carrying on a taxable activity in Vanuatu, (ii) payment is received in foreign currency from overseas, (iii) the contract, creation, delivery, and acceptance of deliverables occur offshore, and (iv) the supplier retains contemporaneous documentary evidence of the offshore transaction. Services physically consumed inside Vanuatu, supplied to Vanuatu residents, or enjoyed within the territory are taxable at 15%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Form C-Ex) processed and cleared in ASYCUDA World, required where physical deliverables such as master files, hard drives, scripts, or marketing materials are shipped
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of any tangible goods; not applicable where deliverance is purely digital
Commercial invoice and countersigned service contract identifying the non-resident recipient and confirming the offshore place of supply
Inward Remittance Certificate, SWIFT MT103 credit advice, or bank statement evidencing receipt of foreign-currency payment from the overseas customer
Digital proof-of-delivery record, delivery acceptance certificate, or client acceptance log for the subtitle and dubbing files
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable - Vanuatu maintains no exchange control legislation, no statutory repatriation obligation, and no prescribed deadline; export proceeds may be retained offshore in any convertible currency. The CIR may raise a deficiency assessment within 4 years from the end of the relevant return period, extended to 8 years in cases of fraud or wilful evasion. Zero-rated export claims are disallowed when the taxpayer fails to produce the shipment, payment, and offshore-recipient evidence bundle; clawback assessments carry a default penalty up to 25% of the unpaid VAT plus ongoing late-payment interest, and the taxpayer's registration may be cancelled. Fraudulent or misleading export zero-rating claims constitute an offence under the VAT Act, punishable by significant fines, imprisonment, director disqualification, and criminal referral to the Office of the State Prosecutor.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), Port Vila, established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act No. 21 of 1988; the RBV is the central bank, monetary authority, banking supervisor, and the delegated foreign-exchange administration under the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 37). Registration and prudential oversight of International Companies is administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act 2008, with the RBV and VFSC jointly maintaining the AML/CFT supervisory framework and external-transaction reporting returns.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is a freely issued, floating currency; Vanuatu operates an open capital account with no prior-approval regime for inward capital, FX conversion, or repatriation by International Companies. Current-account convertibility is unrestricted for cross-border services (AI subtitling, dubbing, post-production), and there are no statutory profit-remittance hurdles: International Companies are non-resident exempt entities and distributions attract no withholding tax. Practical constraints are structural rather than regulatory: the VUV interbank market is thin, correspondent-banking access is concentrated in Australian nostro banks, and offshore VUV positions are effectively non-deliverable; therefore treasury flows should be executed in AUD/USD with VUV balances minimized.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirement and no mandatory conversion ratio exists under the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 37) or RBV prudential rules. Exporters and service providers may retain 100% of export and services receipts in designated foreign-currency accounts with authorized dealers and may convert at will. The only compliance obligations are (i) accurate recording in the dealer's external-transactions statistical return and (ii) retention of underlying service contracts and invoices to support source-of-funds verification; for AI subtitle services, platform settlement statements from Stripe/Wise or downstream aggregators must be reconcilable to client agreements and purchase orders.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (external account) and USD/AUD/VUV Operational Account
AUD/VUV Operational Account with dedicated USD foreign-currency wrapper
Capital Escrow Account and VUV/EUR Operational Account
Operational Account (state-owned book, subject to enhanced RBV prudential supervision)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Moderate for direct onboarding and settlement. Stripe does not offer acquiring to Vanuatu-registered entities, and Wise Business does not provide a native VUV local account; both can be routed only through a licensed payment facilitator or third-country EMI. Recommended construct: (i) hold the RBV-licensed ANZ or BSP account as the legal settlement spine; (ii) layer a regulated fintech EMI (Airwallex, Currenxie, or a multi-currency global account at a top-tier Singapore or Hong Kong bank) to capture Stripe/Wise receivables in USD/AUD; and (iii) sweep balances to the Vanuatu operational account via SWIFT MT103 on settlement-date cycles. Interposing a foreign EMI without disclosure to the Vanuatu bank triggers correspondent-bank de-risking and frozen-credit risk, so the EMI relationship must be declared in the account mandate and KYC file.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening is procedurally possible at ANZ and BSP only where the full corporate pack is certified by a VFSC-registered agent and the first director or 25%-or-higher beneficial owner completes a live, video-recorded KYC interview; in practice, however, the onboarding committee will require an in-person appearance at the Port Vila branch for a first-time International Company before activating the Capital Escrow Account mandate. Foreign-consular notarization without a branch interview is not accepted for the inaugural account; wet-ink board resolutions and the original signed account mandate must be physically delivered. Subsequent signatories may be onboarded with certified passport copies and proof of residential address.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Automatic high-risk classification of the entity as an offshore tax-exempt International Company (private-wealth vehicle archetype)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC certified pack: certificate of incorporation, charter and memorandum, current good standing certificate, beneficial-ownership register identifying all holders at or above 25%, and the registered agent's license and confirmatory letter. Add a certification of economic substance: auditable business plan for AI subtitle transcription and voice cloning, client pipeline, service-level agreements, and a trailing invoice schedule proving operational reality in the ISIC 5912 / NAICS 512191 scope.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth opacity on shareholder contributions funding the Capital Escrow Account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six months of bank statements from the subscribing shareholder's FATF-jurisdiction account, source-of-wealth narrative, signed subscription agreement and board resolution, capital verification worksheet, and confirmation that no bearer shares exist. This package is the decisive condition for escrow release and conversion of the account to unrestricted operational status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payout aggregation through Stripe/Wise or other EMIs flagged as undisclosed third-party beneficiaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform settlement statements for the trailing 12 months, underlying purchase orders and end-client contracts, subcontractor and AI-tool licensing agreements, and a reconciled UBO register matching the EMI wallet operator to the disclosed counterparty profile. The narrative must characterize the EMI strictly as a payment-processing utility, not as a beneficiary or shareholder.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 50 plus USD 5 per month; continued default may lead to removal from the International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Agent Confirmation and Registered Office Attestation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent non-confirmation may trigger administrative strike-off proceedings and restrictions on transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Every calendar year by 31 December for continued tax-exempt status under the International Companies Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Loss of tax exemption for the relevant year; potential monetary penalty and cancellation of exempt status.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory audit for International Companies unless the company holds a VFSC license, exceeds 10 shareholders, is a regulated financial business, or is otherwise directed by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) for entities required to prepare statutory accounts; otherwise simplified accounting as permitted under the International Companies Act

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must confirm the register of beneficial owners annually through its licensed registered agent; any change in shareholding or beneficial ownership must be filed with the agent for VFSC record purposes.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0.00% (Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no branch profits tax; an International Company (IC) is subject to no income-tax legislation at all — Vanuatu has not enacted an Income Tax Act).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective CIT equals the statutory rate of 0%. No tax holiday or preferential deduction applies because none is needed. Recurring fiscal obligations of the IC are instead: (i) VFSC annual registration/annual return fees, scaled to authorized share capital (the minimum bracket, up to USD 5,000 authorized capital, attracts USD 100 per annum; higher brackets rise in fixed steps); (ii) the annual Vanuatu Business Licence fee, assessed by activity class (audio post-production is a standard services class); and (iii) VAT at 12.5% imposed only on taxable supplies made in or imported into Vanuatu once a VUV 5,000,000 registration threshold is crossed; exports of AI subtitle/dubbing services to non-residents are zero-rated. There is no payroll tax, no social security contribution, and no compulsory employee fund for a non-resident-workforce IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The mandatory annual filing instrument is the 'VFSC Annual Return / Confirmation Statement' lodged under the Companies Act (Cap 191) with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the VFSC Online Registry (e-portal: www.vfsc.vu), acting through the IC's licensed registered agent in Port Vila.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; the corresponding annual fee is payable by the anniversary date. A late fee accrues until filing and payment are completed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Company name, registration number, and registered office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the International Company, its IC registration number, and the address of the registered office in Port Vila (must be the office of the licensed agent).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficial owner does not appear in the public register unless named as a director; the registered agent files all details and must be licensed under the Vanuatu Companies Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 — Authorized and issued share capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of authorized capital, issued shares, class rights, and the aggregate consideration received. There is no statutory minimum paid-up capital and capital can be expressed in USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, or VUV.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of the shares; no Vanuatu exchange-control approval or immigration permit is required for share issuance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 — Directors, secretary, and registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identity of at least one director (natural person or company), any secretary, and the licensed registered agent. For a legacy International Company, directors may be non-resident and corporate directors are allowed under the preserved International Companies Act regime.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Appointment of a non-resident director is permitted; the registered agent must have a physical office in Vanuatu and must be a VFSC-licensed company. No nominee director is required by statute.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the beneficial ownership register required under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing rules is held by the registered agent, including ultimate natural-person owners and their proportionate interests.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The beneficial-ownership data is not publicly filed; it is held privately by the agent for AML/CFT inspection and is accessible to the VFSC upon request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 — Declaration of compliance and permitted activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration that the IC has not undertaken business in Vanuatu's domestic market, has complied with the Companies Act and any applicable Business Licence conditions, and has no tax liabilities outstanding.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sign by an authorized director or the agent under power of attorney; the IC must confirm that its AI subtitle/dubbing services are supplied exclusively to non-residents to preserve the zero-tax and zero-WHT position.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission of the Annual Return attracts a penalty of VUV 50,000 (approximately USD 415) per month or part of a month in addition to the annual fee. Non-payment of the annual fee for six months authorizes the Registrar to strike off the company; reinstatement thereafter requires payment of all arrears, a reinstatement fee of VUV 100,000 (approximately USD 830), and a newly renewed Business Licence. Directors remain jointly and severally liable for these amounts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (Form V-2) under the Value Added Tax Act (Cap 297), filed with the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Service (VRCS); electronic or prescribed paper filing is accepted, though mandatory registration applies only where turnover in Vanuatu exceeds VUV 5,000,000 or where the IC makes wholly local taxable supplies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Monthly taxable period; return and full VAT payment due on or before the 15th day of the calendar month following the end of the taxable period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate consideration for AI subtitle transcription, voice-cloning, and dubbing services exported to non-resident clients. Exports of services to a non-resident recipient where the services are consumed wholly outside Vanuatu are zero-rated at 0%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Keep client tax-residency evidence and the underlying service contracts; the non-resident status of the client must be documented to sustain zero-rating on any VRCS audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Supplies physically performed in Vanuatu for residents or services enjoyed in Vanuatu, taxed at 12.5%. An AI dubbing studio producing subtitles delivered to a Vanuatu domestic broadcaster would be caught here.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned IC should have no entries unless it elects to serve the Vanuatu domestic market, which would disturb the International-Company zero-tax profile and should normally be avoided.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recoverable 12.5% input VAT on cloud GPU credits, transcoding software, agent fees, and office costs, to the extent attributable to taxable supplies. Exported-services businesses generally recover all input VAT and file a nil or refund position.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only with tax invoices in the IC's name; unregistered non-resident suppliers' invoices are ineligible, and the IC must keep original VAT invoices for 7 years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 — Net VAT payable to VRCS
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output tax (Box 1 + Box 2) less input tax (Box 3). A typical export-only AI studio shows a nil payable amount and may claim a refund of excess input credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign exchange conversions follow VRCS exchange-rate rules published quarterly; remittance by international wire from the IC's Wise/Stripe settlement account is accepted only where the payee is the registered taxpayer.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VAT return: fixed penalty of VUV 25,000 (approximately USD 207) per return. Late payment: 5% once-off penalty plus interest at 10% per annum. Knowingly submitting a materially false VAT return is an offence carrying a fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 (approximately USD 8,300) and imprisonment up to five years on conviction.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no undistributed-profits tax, and no branch-repatriation tax. Dividends, distributions, and capital distributions paid by an International Company to any non-resident shareholder are free of Vanuatu tax and do not require a clearance certificate or remittance filing.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no Double Tax Agreements, no Tax Information Exchange Agreements with major economies, and no domestic WHT code against which a DTA relief claim could be processed. If a foreign payor nevertheless withholds on payments to the IC, the practical protocol is: (1) request a Certificate of Tax Status / Tax Residency Certificate from the VRCS and/or the VFSC evidencing that the IC is resident for tax purposes in Vanuatu and that Vanuatu levies no income tax; (2) deliver the certificate, the IC incorporation documents, and a completed foreign withholding form (e.g., IRS Form W-8BEN-E for the US, in which case no treaty rate is available) to the payor's withholding agent; (3) if the payor's state maintains no treaty with Vanuatu, accept the statutory source withholding and negotiate a gross-up in the licence or service contract. Structurally, senior group IP licensing should not sit inside the Vanuatu IC unless the operating margins can absorb irrecoverable foreign WHT, because no treaty network exists to reduce those source-state taxes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu statutory WHT: 0% on royalties and interest paid or received by an IC. Vanuatu levies no tax on outbound payments. However, because Vanuatu lacks treaty protection, the counterparty's source-country law governs the economic cost: U.S.-source royalty withholding is 30% absent a treaty, while treaty-origin jurisdictions such as the UK, Germany, or France will withhold at their domestic rates (typically 15% to 25%) with no Vanuatu route to reductions. Interest sourced in the counterparty's jurisdiction is likewise withheld at source-country statutory rates. The recommended drafting measure is recharacterizing the cross-border revenue from royalty to service revenue where the AI subtitling and voice-cloning activities are genuinely performed, and adding a cost-plus service fee or TNMM-based remuneration so that the Vanuatu IC retains no more than arm's-length operating profit.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Vanuatu transfer-pricing statute, Local File, or Master File obligation exists. The administratively recommended threshold for voluntary arm's-length documentation is VUV 100,000,000 (approximately USD 830,000) in aggregate related-party cross-border services revenue per financial year; above that level, a foreign audit or an OECD/EU enquiry is materially more likely to demand contemporaneous documentation, a group economic-substance file, and allocation of profit to value-generating employees and servers in the AI post-production workflow.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted OECD/EU-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR). Nevertheless, the jurisdiction is monitored by the FATF, the OECD Global Forum, and the EU Code of Conduct Group; the VFSC requires the IC to maintain (i) a licensed registered agent in Port Vila, (ii) a physical registered office in Vanuatu, and (iii) adequate accounting records. An AI dubbing studio cannot rely on formal compliance: Stripe, Wise, and correspondent banks apply substance-based KYC, and foreign tax authorities will apply their own ESR/CBCR rules. The recommended substance blueprint for ISIC 5912 includes at least one resident director participating in board decisions, a Port Vila office, local bookkeeping/log archiving, employee or contractor agreements governed by Vanuatu law, and demonstrable control over the subtitle/voice-cloning IP conducted from records held in Vanuatu, even if heavy compute is executed on foreign cloud infrastructure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Foreign-Source Withholding Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring the US/EU AI subtitle and voice-cloning contracts so that all royalty income is attributed to the Vanuatu IC while all design, development, quality control, and client-facing activity is physically performed and managed in the client's country, and no arm's-length intercompany fee is charged to the operating affiliate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In Vanuatu: false declaration in the Annual Return or Business Licence application under the Penal Code (Cap 135) is an offence carrying a fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 (approximately USD 8,300) and imprisonment up to five years; the VFSC may additionally impose an administrative penalty of VUV 300,000 (approximately USD 2,490) for deceptive filings. In the source country: reassessment of the full gross revenue, denial of deductions, 100% gross-up assessments, and civil fraud penalties between 50% and 75% of the tax due.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign the false declaration or knowingly direct the scheme are personally liable for civil restitution of the foreign tax avoided, may be disqualified by the VFSC for up to 10 years, and face extradition exposure in the source jurisdiction. The corporate veil is pierced because the IC is a sham; the shareholder's personal assets, including the AI voice models and subtitling catalogs, are reachable by foreign tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Failure of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC with no office, no employees, no board minutes, no bank-account activity in Vanuatu, and no records of any kind, while using Stripe and Wise to collect large volumes of subtitle/dubbing revenue and immediately wiring balances to a foreign parent or personal account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar will strike the company off the register for failure to provide details of effective management; the IC's contracts, including cloud SaaS subscriptions and licensing agreements, become voidable; the Business Licence is revoked; the IC loses limited-liability protection. Multilateral consequence: the entity is classified as a shell under OECD/EU action, triggering refusal of tax clearance, automatic CFC taxation in the shareholder's residence state, and closure of Stripe, Wise, and banking facilities due to de-risking by processors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: After veil-piercing, shareholders and directors are jointly and severally liable for all IC debts; each director may be fined up to VUV 500,000 (approximately USD 4,150) and disqualified for 10 years. Non-resident principals are also exposed to travel bans issued by foreign tax courts and to local criminal proceedings once the VFSC refers the matter to the Public Prosecutor.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving subtitle/voice-dubbing client funds through the IC's Stripe and Wise accounts without maintaining a beneficial-ownership register, without identifying the ultimate human beneficiaries of the AI-generated content payments, or without filing Suspicious Transaction Reports where the transaction patterns indicate money laundering or third-party client pass-throughs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing legislation, the IC and its registered agent face a fine of up to VUV 10,000,000 (approximately USD 83,000) and the responsible natural persons face imprisonment up to 10 years for money-laundering offences; VFSC administrative penalties for deficient AML systems reach VUV 500,000 (approximately USD 4,150) per breach.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the beneficial owner face civil asset-confiscation, freezing orders over the IC's IP, travel bans, and imprisonment. Regulators treat the AI voice-cloning and subtitle catalogs as confiscatable proceeds; personal liability attaches because the AML obligations attach to the beneficial owner, not only the nominal director, and the corporation's veil will not shield a principal who personally directed the payment structuring.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Statutory Filing Default and Business Licence Lapse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing for two consecutive filing cycles to submit the VFSC Annual Return, pay the annual fee, renew the Vanuatu Business Licence, or file nil VAT returns while continuing to stream revenue through Stripe and Wise.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory strike-off by the Registrar; the company is dissolved, its assets vest in the state subject to claims, and its contracts become voidable at the counterparty's option. The cumulative financial sanction includes annual-return penalties of VUV 50,000 per month (approximately USD 415), a VUV 100,000 reinstatement fee (approximately USD 830), VRCS penalties of VUV 100,000 (approximately USD 830), and all accrued annual fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The directors remain jointly and severally liable for debts incurred during the default period, including the unpaid fees of the registered agent and any VRCS assessments; a travel ban may be imposed by the VFSC pending clearance of arrears, and further imprisonment of up to two years is possible for trading after the company has been dissolved.
